seoTitle: How to Add Postage Costs on eBay (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Learn how to set shipping charges on eBay in 2026 — flat rate, calculated shipping, free shipping, or international postage — from desktop and mobile.
intro: Setting the right shipping price on eBay affects both your profit margin and how competitive your listing looks to buyers. This guide walks through the different postage options eBay offers and how to apply them so you neither overcharge buyers nor eat into your margins on delivery costs.

steps.heading: Choose a shipping method
steps.body: Decide between a flat rate (one fixed price regardless of buyer location) or calculated shipping, where eBay works out the cost from the item's weight, dimensions, and the buyer's address.

steps.heading: Enter package details
steps.body: For calculated shipping, provide accurate weight and package dimensions so eBay can pull real carrier rates instead of guessing, which helps avoid under- or overcharging.

steps.heading: Decide on free shipping
steps.body: You can build the shipping cost into your item price and offer 'free shipping,' which often improves visibility in search results, or keep it as a separate line item.

steps.heading: Add international options
steps.body: If you ship abroad, set separate international rates or use eBay's international shipping programs so overseas buyers see accurate costs at checkout.

steps.heading: Apply a shipping policy across listings
steps.body: Save your shipping setup as a business policy so you can reuse the same rates across multiple listings instead of configuring shipping every time.

faq.question: Should I offer free shipping or charge separately on eBay?
faq.answer: Free shipping (with the cost folded into the item price) can boost search ranking, but calculated or flat shipping gives buyers more price transparency — test both to see what sells better for your items.

faq.question: How does eBay calculate shipping cost?
faq.answer: Calculated shipping uses the weight and dimensions you enter plus the buyer's delivery address to pull live rates from carriers like USPS, FedEx, or UPS.

faq.question: Can I set different shipping costs for different countries?
faq.answer: Yes, you can configure separate domestic and international shipping rates, or exclude certain regions entirely from your listing.

faq.question: Can I update shipping costs on a listing that's already live?
faq.answer: Yes, you can edit shipping details on active listings from both the desktop site and the eBay mobile app without having to relist the item.
